text.ja: 受動Lorentz・Ohmic分散Maxwell場 \partial_t\mathbf H=-\nabla\times\mathbf E,\quad\varepsilon_\infty\partial_t\mathbf E=\nabla\times\mathbf H-\sigma\mathbf E-\mathbf J \partial_t\mathbf P=\mathbf J,\quad\partial_t\mathbf J=f\mathbf E-\omega_0^2\mathbf P-\gamma\mathbf J,\quad f=\Delta\varepsilon\omega_0^2 \varepsilon_\infty>0,\quad f,\sigma,\gamma\ge0 正の物質エネルギーと直接Ohmic/γ仕事を持つ単一受動Lorentz極。代表式は3Dですが、実装は周期y単一kyの2D s/p成分制限です。PML数値仕事は物理散逸と同一視しません。
text.en: Passive Lorentz–Ohmic Maxwell fields \partial_t\mathbf H=-\nabla\times\mathbf E,\quad\varepsilon_\infty\partial_t\mathbf E=\nabla\times\mathbf H-\sigma\mathbf E-\mathbf J \partial_t\mathbf P=\mathbf J,\quad\partial_t\mathbf J=f\mathbf E-\omega_0^2\mathbf P-\gamma\mathbf J,\quad f=\Delta\varepsilon\omega_0^2 \varepsilon_\infty>0,\quad f,\sigma,\gamma\ge0 A single passive Lorentz pole with positive material energy and direct Ohmic/gamma work. The representative equations are three-dimensional; the implemented solver is the two-dimensional s/p component restriction at one periodic ky. Numerical PML work is not identified with physical dissipation.
